lessons_used: Predictions have been consistently too high across all tests relative to measured results.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign changes, as there is only one test so far.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy and redesign changes, with only one test for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish copy and new_screen changes, with only one test for each.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and wait_info changes, with only one test for each.

candidates.title: Desktop Welcome Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home welcome screen with a spotlight layout highlighting the desktop pet mascot and explicit instructions on desktop placement.
candidates.why: 34.2% drop-off at finish with support tickets indicating users are confused about how to locate or interact with their pet on the desktop screen.

home_intro.headline: Welcome your pet to your desktop screen!

home_welcome.text: Click and drag your new companion anywhere on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen while keeping its core job and staying within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%) and strong support evidence, but redesigns carry mixed risk and cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Habit Preview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new preview screen before path selection showing animated pet behaviors to engage users early.
candidates.why: 23.8% drop-off at path selection with high median and mean times (8s / 514s), suggesting users need clearer context on pet capabilities before picking a creation path.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview your companion's daily habits
new_pet_preview.body: See how virtual pets interact with your desktop apps, play games, and respond to your work day.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new preview screen inside onboarding while maintaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High friction from inserting a new screen; past new_screen test yielded negative conversion impact.

candidates.title: Account Save Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in preserves pet memories and prevents data loss upon app restarts.
candidates.why: Sign in loses 27.1% of users, and 8 support tickets specifically report missing pets or resets after re-signing in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in backs up your pet's memory and state so it is never lost when reopening the desktop app.

guard.reason: Adds an informative hint to sign-in without introducing dark patterns or modifying pricing.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between sign_in drop-off (27.1%) and support tickets; cheap hint update with high expected return.

candidates.title: Grid-Based Pet Selection Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet pick screen into a grid layout displaying ready-to-adopt pets alongside custom pet creation options.
candidates.why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (33.8%) and a long mean time (1017s), showing users get stuck choosing or understanding creation choices.

pick_friend.headline: Select or craft your ideal companion

pet_choices.text: Choose a pre-made pet or generate a unique companion from your photos.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Setup Wait Info
candidates.change: Display an accurate time estimate and interactive waiting tips explaining the desktop engine installation.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off; support reported pets failing to show up or stalling.

waiting.headline: Setting up your desktop pet engine...
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet's desktop rendering engine and animation states.

guard.reason: Adds accurate setup time estimation and tips to the waiting screen as permitted by the rules.

candidates.score_note: High wait time and support ticket backing, but historical wait_info test delivered only +0.1% lift.

candidates.title: Onboarding Completion Quick Tips Screen
candidates.change: Add a final quick tips screen outlining simple mouse actions (drag, right-click, hide) before launching to desktop.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received multiple reports from users who were confused about controlling, hiding, or talking to their pet after setup.

new_quick_tips.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_quick_tips.body: Here is how to interact with your pet once it lands on your desktop.

components.text: Right-click pet for main menu; Click & drag to move pet; Double-click to trigger pet trick.

guard.reason: Adds a quick tips screen after home_intro, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops off significantly, but adding extra screens on finish previously lowered conversion.

candidates.title: Path Selector Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on path selection to set expectations around quick setup versus photo customization.
candidates.why: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation on this screen due to unclear path differences.

choose_path.headline: Select your companion creation method
choose_path.body: Pick a classic ready-to-play pet for instant launch, or generate a custom pet from your photos in under 1 minute.

guard.reason: Updates path selection copy clearly while preserving both adoption and custom pet options.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median/mean time on path selection; copy updates on choose_path showed positive lift (+2.7%).

candidates.title: Two-Column Photo Customizer Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the upload photos step into a two-column view showing live render preview beside the photo uploader.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results, causing drop-offs during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload photos for custom pet generation

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Card Layout Sign In Redesign
candidates.change: Reframe the sign-in screen into a centered card layout displaying step progress.
candidates.why: 27.1% of overall funnel drops off at sign in, with users spending substantial time before authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to activate companion sync
sign_in.body: Create or sign into your account to save your companion across desktop launches.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in into a card layout while maintaining screen purpose and onboarding compliance.

candidates.score_note: Targets sign_in drop-off, but evidence relies only on funnel stats without support mail validation.

candidates.title: Split Layout Desktop Loading Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split view with progress bar on one side and feature tip carousel on the other.
candidates.why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s); keeping users engaged during loading reduces drop-off right before completion.

wait_status.text: Did you know? You can minimize your pet to the system tray anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen with a split layout while continuing to convey pet creation status.

candidates.score_note: Helps engage users during long loading (2336s mean), but implementation cost is high for uncertain redesign gains.

lessons_next: Predictions continue to be consistently too high relative to measured results across almost all tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign changes, as there is only one test so far.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy changes as results disagree after noise correction, and thin for choose_path redesign with only one test.
Evidence is still thin for finish changes (copy, new_screen, redesign), with only one test for each.
Evidence is still thin for home changes (new_flow, redesign, wait_info), with only one test for each and no clear effect seen for home redesign.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in hint changes, with only one test so far.
